requirements.description: Errors caused by context.Canceled, including wrapped ones, are returned with gRPC code Canceled by the error interceptor.
requirements.source: requirements bullet 1; reference ErrorUnaryInterceptor errors.Is(err, context.Canceled)
requirements.alternatives: switch case or early return; additional ctx.Err()/ErrCanceled checks

requirements.description: Errors caused by context.DeadlineExceeded, including wrapped ones, are returned with gRPC code DeadlineExceeded.
The auth interceptor does not turn context-derived errors into Unauthenticated; it propagates Canceled/DeadlineExceeded.
requirements.alternatives: return status error directly, or return the raw context error for the error interceptor to classify

requirements.description: Context-unrelated error handling and successful flows keep their behaviour.
